entry: Candidate B; ordinary compiled calls enter internal bodies, genuine Wasm tail transfers retain the accepted legality rules.
conditions: D1 standard instances with wrapper identity and owner-linked slot vectors. Twelve sealed bootstrap classes have slot order/defaults independently exported from pristine native U1. Type datum/expected-type and cell-error name are generated readers. Ancestor masks live in the owner class registry, not private condition payload vectors.
class_boundary: The owner supplies this sealed bootstrap registry and wrapper identities. General CLOS metaclass construction, class redefinition and generic accessors remain LL11; symbol/package installation remains LL09. This is not a complete MAKE-CONDITION or TYPEP implementation.
restarts: Generated RESTART-CASE, RESTART-BIND, FIND-RESTART, INVOKE-RESTART and RESTART-NAME with active identity, nearest/first matching restart, dynamic retirement and full values. U1-shaped restart istructs. Anonymous names, report/test/interactive options and condition association are explicit source refusals; general restart enumeration is outside this subset.
debugger: Ordinary error-service mode invokes a generated *DEBUGGER-HOOK* with itself dynamically masked, rooted condition and restored depth; hook transfers can invoke restarts. No interactive UI debugger is supplied. Bootstrap or declined errors end in structured checked Wasm diagnostics, not engine traps.
checks: B-mode cons reads/writes, SVREF, arity/keywords, callable designators, missing THROW target, special unbound reads and improper APPLY arguments enter the condition path. Invalid owner metadata, hard limits and unsupported operations remain checked fatal refusals. Legacy no-handler cons diagnostics preserve the accepted exception tag and operands.
stacks: Owner bounds VSP, temporary arena and separate 16-byte CSP entries. A configured reserve separates soft STORAGE-CONDITION from hard fatal exhaustion. The reserve is rearmed on transfer; nested exhaustion is checked. Byte budgets are target resource cases, not native stack-size equivalence. The full owner initializes CSP; zero CSP base is the inherited fixture compatibility path.
interrupts: Explicit polls and interrupt re-enable consult the dynamic interrupt level, claim only the Lisp-interrupt pending bit and permit the collector service while masked. The collector callback is a service witness, not moving GC or a complete entry/backedge poll insertion policy.
roots: Condition/restart slots, binding records, indirect result descriptors, stack callables and pending exceptions keep their stated root obligations. Moving-collector validation/reloads remain LL06/LL18; no collection during indivisible construction/store windows is claimed.
owner: Single Worker, owner-authenticated lazy catalog and owner-issued symbols/metadata. The inherited symbols import namespace also carries immutable condition registry and expected-type objects. Multi-Worker publication and host re-entry across a pending exception remain later loader/runtime work.
performance: No timing claim. No public-wrapper dispatch on compiled calls. Failure paths validate conditions and allocate their instances; ordinary successful checks do not construct conditions. General dynamic-result demand propagation remains open.
integration: Proposal only, applied in disposable pristine U1 copies. Shared checkout compiler/runtime and upstream kernel unchanged. Claude review and user acceptance required before integration.
